programs.title: The Equalizer
programs.desc: Robert McCall gives up violence and wishes to lead a quiet life. However, brutal events force him to take up the fight for justice once again.

programs.title: The Man From Toronto
programs.desc: A struggling entrepreneur plans a surprise for his wife's birthday, but due to a twist of fate, he gets caught in the middle of an operation to apprehend an assassin.

programs.title: Daddio
programs.desc: A woman takes a cab ride back home from the airport. En route, she unexpectedly has an insightful conversation with the driver regarding the important relationships in life.

programs.title: Resident Evil: Apocalypse
programs.desc: Alice wakes up to find that Raccoon city is infested with zombies and monsters. Later, she tries her best to find a way out of the city before it is too late.

programs.title: Never Back Down 2: The Beatdown
programs.desc: Four fighters from different backgrounds come together to train under a former MMA star. Ultimately, they have to fight each other and also the traitor who hides among them.

programs.title: Salt
programs.desc: CIA agent Evelyn Salt's life takes an ugly turn when she is accused of planning the assassination of the Russian president. However, she flees and sets out to prove her innocence.

programs.title: Alpha
programs.desc: Keda, the young son of a tribe chief, is accidentally left behind and must survive in the wilderness. He then encounters an injured wolf abandoned by its pack and the two form a bond.

programs.title: Anacondas: The Hunt for the Blood Orchid
programs.desc: A team of researchers is in Borneo to find the blood orchid, a flower that could hold the secret to eternal life. However, the scientists run afoul of the jungle's deadly snakes.

programs.title: Bad Boys: Ride or Die
programs.desc: Mike and Marcus face their toughest case yet as their late captain's reputation hangs in the balance. Subsequently, they unravel a complex web of cartel connections in a high-stakes mission.

programs.title: Kraven the Hunter
programs.desc: Prepped to be the successor of his father's drug empire, a near-death experience alters Sergei's physicality. Sergei now treads the path of vengeance as he hunts criminals.

programs.title: Morbius
programs.desc: Determined to cure the disease that has plagued him his entire life, Morbius conducts a drastic experiment, which bears unforeseen consequences.

programs.title: Venom: The Last Dance
programs.desc: As Eddie and Venom are tirelessly pursued by forces from both of their worlds, they find themselves out of options and left with a shattering last resort.

programs.title: Anaconda
programs.desc: A documentary crew, who are on a mission to find a tribe named Shirishamas, helps a snake hunter when they find him stranded. However, he forces them to risk their lives and hunt down an anaconda.

programs.title: Gran Turismo
programs.desc: With the help of a mechanic having a tragic past, an avid player of racing video games attempts to become a professional car racer.

programs.title: Bloodshot
programs.desc: A soldier who died on duty is resurrected and given superhuman abilities by the RST Corp. But soon he realises the truth about his past and his resurrection and sets out to get revenge.

programs.title: After Earth
programs.desc: A father-son duo crash-land on Earth, a millennium after an accident forced humans to evacuate the planet. With the father grievously injured, the son must put his life on the line to secure help.

programs.title: The International
programs.desc: Louis, an Interpol agent, and Eleanor, a district attorney, learn that their lives at risk after they team up to track the money that a bank is using to fund terrorism.
